newsitem.title: INDIA: Israel's Weizman outraged by Indian train bomb.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Weizman outraged by Indian train bomb.

text.p: Israeli President Ezer Weizman said on Tuesday he was shocked and outraged by the bombing of an Indian train on Monday in which some 300 people were feared killed.

"It was with great sorrow, deep shock and rage that I learned of the senseless killing of 300 innocent passengers on board the train in Assam," Weizman said in a letter to Indian President Shankar Dayal Sharma, made available to Reuters by Israeli officials.
"On behalf of the people of Israel and personally, I would like to express my heartfelt condolences on this tragic incident," Weizman, on the third day of his first visit to India, said.

Weizman told Reuters on Tuesday he had discussed the general issue of global terrorism with Indian Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda a few hours before at least two blasts triggered by suspected Bodo tribal militants in Assam wrecked the train.
